key.name: launch
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that launches the Peek GIF recorder. Defaults to Ctrl+Shift+P. Change it with e.g.: dconf write /org/gnome/shell/extensions/peek/launch "['<Control><Shift>o']"

key.name: binary
key.description: Absolute path to the peek-rs binary. Empty means auto-detect: ~/.local/bin/peek-rs, /usr/local/bin/peek-rs, then PATH.
